meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

copy.tagline: 将工作分解为可执行的系统步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将复杂目标拆解为有条理的行动步骤
copy.tagline_en: Decompose work into systematic, actionable steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break down complex goals into methodical steps

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按ulw-loop工作流将任务分解为有证据约束的系统性步骤，包括注册目标、更新检查清单、记录证据，且证据必须来自真实界面。
howto.when: 当用户提到“ulw-loop”、“ulw”等关键词，或要求持久目标执行、证据驱动的工作时触发。

say.text: 使用ulw-loop完成这个长期任务。
say.note: 启动目标循环，自动分解步骤。

say.text: 记录当前步骤的证据并更新检查清单。
say.note: 触发证据记录和清单更新。

say.text: 由于上下文丢失，重新读取状态并继续。

howto.what_en: After loading, Claude will use the ulw-loop workflow to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps: register goals, update checklists, and record evidence from real surfaces.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions "ulw-loop", "ulw", or requests durable goal execution, evidence-led work, etc.

say_en.text: Start ulw-loop to decompose this long-running task.
Record evidence for the current step and update the checklist.
say_en.note: Triggers evidence recording and checklist update.

say_en.text: Re-read state after context loss and resume.
